text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Kiseki! Here comes Kiseki!!
Kicking through the mud, reaching for the chrysanthemum crown, it's Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Seize it, seize ittt!
Stretch those legs! Seize the ground!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I lose all feeling in my toes!
My body remembers what to do!!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*...――ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki! It's Kiseki!
Tearing through the rain, into the downpour—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Kiseki takes first place and crossssses the finish liiiiiine!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of running was that?!" "Incredible stamina!"
"She really held on at the end, didn't she?!" "So strong!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki!” “Kiseki~!” “Congratulations!”
“Kiseki, you're the best!!” “That was so much fun!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah......!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...You saw it through to the end, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Is Kiseki-san also into "festivals"—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Incredible, Kiseki...!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing! So cool!!
Boo's gonna run in next year's Kikuka Sho too! I'm definitely running in it!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...gh..., I learned a hell of a lot from that...!
Since we're from different generations, our direct clash will have to wait.
—...Hey, Ai-san...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ……? ……Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it...—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I want to win...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look, this newspaper is covering my Kikuka Sho too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One week after the Kikuka Sho.
Kiseki was scouring the internet for impressions.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"High hopes for Kiseki going forward!"
"That Kikuka Sho was truly a race for the history books."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki takes her first strides toward becoming the strongest.”
...Oho! Ohohoho!
choice_data_list: —"Next year, she will be the main character."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I read out the headlines of the news articles gathered on my smartphone to Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
……Aaaaargh!!
Yes, I'll be the main character! I will!!
choice_data_list: Everyone is expecting great things from you.
Everyone is placing their hopes on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's race this time was,
without question, an "entertaining race."
The surrounding praise proved it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—this single victory is not the entirety of Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... It's already decided~...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Kiseki's” story isn't over yet!
After the center color pages,
comes the cover feature!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So next time—let's do the #1 fan-favorite, ultra-popular flagship manga!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It has to be the Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spring Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen.
A 2,200-meter turf clash at Hanshin Racecourse featuring Umamusume endowed with both popularity and prowess.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'll make my move there as well.
choice_data_list: Oh, I wonder what it is. I'm looking forward to it
Huh, I wonder what it is. I can't wait~

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Please look forward to the plot outline
for the start of the new chapter!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki immediately began pondering tactics
for his next goal, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that wasn't all we came here for today.
...It's about time I got out of here.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! That was close...!
Alright, let's head out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After leaving the shop and walking for a bit,
we arrive at the grandstand of Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan invited me!
—She asked me to come to today's Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, the rain's insane though!
This typhoon is crazy, huh?! But—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The cheers for Kita-chan
aren't losing to this strong wind at all...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
“Kita-chaaaaaan!”
“We're rooting for you~!” “You're my hero!”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
I'll give it my all today too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Starting with this Tenno Sho (Autumn),
followed by the Japan Cup and the Arima Kinen,
let's get hyped for the Autumn Senior Triple Crown!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —Please watch over my grand finale!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...A glorious farewell...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A faint sense of unease lingered for a split second.
And then, the race began.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And the Tenno Sho (Autumn) has begun!
Once again, the race favorite Kitasan Black is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A late start?! Kitasan Black
has begun the race from the back of the pack!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh!? Is Kita-chan okay!?"
"S-She'll be fine. It's her, after all... right!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Known for her Front-Runner and Leader style,
Kitasan Black's unexpected position causes a stir in the stands. However—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Kita-chan isn't panicking at all. Far from it—...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――! Trainer,
the way Kita-chan's running right now is...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Incredible! Kitasan Black dives right into the utterly chewed-up inside track!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And her late kick surges! She's extending her lead!!
Kitasan Black's explosive finish is in full force!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black takes 1st place!!
She seals the victory with a brilliant late charge!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: …………――Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"With the same 'late-charging' style as me,
Kita-chan won...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
……Aaaaargh! Is this—is this why
Kita-chan called me here?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Is it a reply saying my work was awesome?!
Or a pitch to collaborate?!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wah, whoa-whoa! I wonder what kind of internal
monologue Kita-chan is running through right now!
Huh... Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki desperately tries to decipher
the message from the big star standing on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her story continues—even further.
First, onward to the Takarazuka Kinen.
